professionalSummary: Experienced Maintenance Planning Coordinator with three years managing weekly maintenance plans for two paper machines, ensuring alignment with production schedules and planning procedures.
experienceHighlights: Built weekly maintenance plans from open work orders per mill planning procedure.
Sequenced shutdown work packages with machine crews, coordinating with production manager approval.
Maintained up-to-date spare parts reservations in collaboration with stores team.
Prepared comprehensive weekly plan reviews for the maintenance manager, documenting changes and feedback.
Documented open items and hand‑over conditions for seamless weekly transitions.
